name: Dlink
description: D-Link is one of the well known IP camera manufacturer and they recently released a new lineup of cloud wireless IP camera with cloud recording feature. The cloud recording allows the recorded footage to be stored in the cloud in D-Link’s server and it comes with various advantages such as timeline view and secure storage. D-Link also promises that their mydlink app will be user-friendly. Let’s take a look on their latest lineup of D-Link cloud camera.
